Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Tools and Productio n.
Topic 4.2: Computer Software
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Computer Software, part of Tools and Productio n. in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: how to handle different application software appropriately. 1. Why is computer software important? 2. How are computer software used in day- to-day life?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
